text_block_list.text: One day, when I took a walk over to a rental shop—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
PriFigh was so good!
I can totally see why Kawakami-chan loves it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even someone of royal blood like you finds it captivating...
PriFai really is the greatest ever~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A movie chosen by Fine-san is sure to be wonderful as well, isn't it♪
choice_data_list: Looks like you two are having fun.
Looks like you two are having fun.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, Trainer!
The anime and movies in this country are so interesting~

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We were talking about watching the movie
I picked out together with Kawakami-chan today—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I know!
Why don't you join in too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You are most welcome~! Watching movies is
so much more hype with more people!
choice_data_list: Then I'll take you up on that offer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's settled~♪
I'll go pick out something extra special for the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The magnificent screening shall now commence~!
Come along, Fine-san♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What I picked is~ a romance movie! The title is—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's "Shark General Returns"! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Mumu, that title is strangely captivating!
Though I fail to see how it relates to romance!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The packaging looked interesting on this one.
Even though it's the first in the series, the title makes it sound like a sequel!

Unable to pour cold water on the two of them
beaming with radiant smiles,
the viewing began.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawa! A girl falling from the sky... Wait, no,
a massive swarm of sharks is falling down upon us?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's a real problem when higher-ups drag their feet during an emergency... While everyone's busy passing the buck, more and more sharks are—!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! The island is floating!?
No way, the entire island was a defense facility...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The tables have turned!
Fire the missile of love, desu wa—!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "'No matter how much of a Shogun it is, it's still a shark.' ...True, if we burn it, we can probably take it down!"

text_block_list.name: Fine & Kawakami
text_block_list.text: Go for it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That was so... super fun!
I really love this work~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"General Shark Returns" is the best!
Don't you think so too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: You're into some surprising things, huh.
Maybe I should watch another movie too...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"General Shark Returns" is the best!
Don't you think so too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: You're into some surprising things, huh.
Maybe I should watch another movie too...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, like the constant barrage of ridiculous twists,
and having no idea what made him a shogun!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
From beginning to end,
it was full of energy and felt so free, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: All the movies I've watched before were about learning customs, philosophies, or ancient history, so this felt so fresh!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it's so much fun watching together
and cheering at the top of our lungs!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I agree completely! If you wouldn't mind having me,
I would be delighted to join you anytime!
Living a life bound by so many restrictions, it was perhaps inevitable that Fine Motion would be drawn to the freedom of B-movies—

I was happy to see that she had found
yet another thing she loved.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well then—
How about "Resurrection of the Zombie Kingdom", "Mecha Umamusume", and "Mystery: Capture the Golden Kappa!"?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There were lots of other movies that caught my eye,
so we won't be running out of options anytime soon!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Maybe I'll tell everyone back
in Ireland about all the fun stuff I found.
I'm sure it'll help broaden their horizons♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Fine-san! If that happens,
please make sure to include PreFie as well!
choice_data_list: W-Wait, maybe we should hold on a sec...!

text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad Fine Motion is enjoying our country's
movies. However—"
To avoid recommending only one type of movie, I resolved to have them watch a wide variety of genres.
